entities.name: Rubén Vargas Ugarte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rubén Vargas Ugarte was a Jesuit priest and Peruvian historian. He was the third president of the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru, and was ordained a priest in the Society of Jesus in 1921. He was also the Director of the National Library of Peru.
